title: Mapped localization cocone comparisons are isomorphisms
statement: Under the hypotheses of the localization leg lemma, let F be any functor that sends the lifted versions of c and d to colimit cocones. Then F.map g is an isomorphism. Definitions and notation: [def-weil-pbc-integral-localization-telescope].

source.place: Lemma 5.3(1), referring to Bhatt–Scholze Lemma 6.8.2; scalar localization telescope

proof.text: The zeroth-leg condition implies compatibility with every leg. Applying F gives a morphism between two colimit cocones. Such a morphism is invertible, and forgetting to its vertex gives the desired isomorphism.

proof_origin.note: B2: explicit scalar telescope construction and categorical compatibility. This auxiliary declaration is proved in the delivery, not a new assumption.

theorem integralLocalization_cocone_map_isIso (ℓ : ℕ)
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Preadditive C]
    {K : C} (c d : Cocone (integralLocalizationSequence ℓ K))
    [IsIso (ℓ • 𝟙 d.pt)] (g : c.pt ⟶ d.pt)
    (hzero : c.ι.app 0 ≫ g = d.ι.app 0)
    {B : Type w} [Category.{x} B] (F : C ⥤ B)
    (hc : IsColimit (F.mapCocone (c.whisker
      (ULift.orderIso : ULift.{y} ℕ ≃o ℕ).equivalence.functor)))
    (hd : IsColimit (F.mapCocone (d.whisker
      (ULift.orderIso : ULift.{y} ℕ ≃o ℕ).equivalence.functor))) :
    IsIso (F.map g)
